title: Autotune is no longer selectable?
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.1.0** (dev branch)
**Build**: bc2cd2c59
**Flavor**: Fullrelease, developer mode

**Problem description:**

Autotune is somehow "disabled"?
On upgrade, tab was removed. Option is still in config builder but is "unselecting" on selection

comments.body:
@MilosKozak @Philoul Reproduction should be easy?
If not, let me know. I'll add logfiles

not on a released version (currently dev  build is 3.1.0 so master release ref).
Autotune is only available on dev with Engineering mode.

@what is the reason to not make it available to the next master ?
Plug-ins like Autotune and the new Dynamic ISF are working perfect and very stable .

Fixed by replacing this line https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/dev/app/build.gradle#L108 with 

> version "3.1.0-dev"
it's already changed to dev again
